messages:
Riley: Hi all 1 posted my resignation this morning. My last day will be 2026-11-12. Couple quick operational items: 1) I have an open relocation reimbursement (signed agreement) 2026-11-01 submitted; will that clear after my final paycheck? 2) How long does health insurance run (I may join spouse plan mid-month). 3) I still have company phone + parking pass. Also need to arrange a knowledge-transfer session for the analytics dashboard.
Ava (People Ops): Hi Riley 1 thanks for the heads-up. Benefits: coverage runs through the last day of the month of termination. If you elect COBRA you'll get the packet within 14 days. If joining spouse plan mid-month we can provide a letter of coverage dates for their HR. Relocation reimbursement: please confirm expense number  we'll coordinate with Finance; post-termination reimbursements can be processed if receipts are submitted within 30 days and approved. I'll confirm the exact routing.
Devon (Payroll): Hey Riley 1 final payroll processes on the next payroll cycle after your termination. Reimbursements: if Finance flags the relocation as a vendor payment it may go through AP and not the payroll run. Submit the relocation expense with receipts and tag it "relocation - post-termination" and cc payroll@. PTO payout: let us know your balance if you want it included.
Riley: PTO ~16 hrs. Please include. Expense submitted as EXP-7894 (relocation). Thanks.
Maya (Manager): Riley please schedule a 60-min KT with the analytics team and drop the dashboard admin creds into the handoff doc. I'll cover the on-call rota for one week post-exit. Also confirm any pending PRs you want frozen vs merged.
Sam (IT): IT notes: we'll disable corporate phone provisioning and parking badge at 5pm local on 2026-11-12. If you need earlier cutover tell us. Return shipping label for the phone will be emailed; you can drop the parking pass in the return envelope. If you have personal SSH keys on company machines remove them and let us know about any shared service accounts.
Facilities: We can accept the physical parking hangtag at reception on 11/12 until 4pm or you can mail it back using the prepaid label Sam mentioned. Badge deactivation scheduled for 17:00 local on last day. If you need a visitor pass for one-time pickup after exit, request it here with date/time.
Ava (People Ops): Quick checklist: 1) Exit interview invite (calendar) will go out; 2) COBRA packet + benefits FAQ to personal email; 3) Relocation reimbursement EXP-7894 routed to Finance/AP; 4) Final payroll + PTO payout confirmed with Devon; 5) IT deprovision + phone return scheduled; 6) Facilities parking pass return logistics set. Riley 1 if you'd like an employment verification letter or a summary of benefits contributions, reply and we'll generate it. :white_check_mark:
Riley: Appreciate it. I've scheduled the KT for 11/03, updated handoff doc, and added PR list (labelled "freeze" or "merge"). I'll DM Devon my bank details if needed. Thanks everyone.
Devon (Payroll): Got it 1 final pay + PTO payout noted. If AP needs anything for EXP-7894 I'll follow up. Bank on file ok unless you tell us otherwise.
Sam (IT): Got the handoff. Will DM about any multi-factor devices and confirm the phone return label once created.
Maya (Manager): Thanks Riley 1 we'll cover the dashboard after your KT. Good luck! :v:
